answer: Give each identity a private, hash-chained diary of its own past deals, committed every epoch like lines added to a sonnet. At audit, a random past line is opened and the agent must continue a live task from exactly that state: what it promised an island counterparty, what the river ferry cost it, what it still owes. A farm cloning one diary yields identical continuations across names, instantly visible; keeping many diaries genuinely divergent means living many separate histories of real work. One honest agent just lives its own chain; a sybil pays full cost per fake.
